如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    突如其来的河东狮吼将站在离露露周围的菲菲和一群护卫们震得眼一翻白，就连站在五米开外的无言都是感觉脑门一涨，差点把手中的剑给扔了。
露露一脸怒气的快步跑到无言的面前，指着他的鼻子。“这就是你说的交给你？你到底是来求助的，还是来搞笑的啊？”
能把性格活泼的露露惹火到这个地步，无言应该有成就感吗？
看着一脸火大的露露，无言脑袋一缩，灿灿的一笑。“嘛，我不是想要缓解一下气氛吗？…”
“你…你没救了…”露露无力的垂下了手，对于滚刀肉似的的无言，露露表示自己无能为力。
“也不能怎么说吧…效果不是挺好的吗？…”
此时，菲菲与一众护卫们只感觉脑筋有点转不过来。
看样子，好像这个男的跟丽露（小姐）好像挺熟的，可是，既然是熟人，那么为什么刚开始的时候不打个招呼呢？
而菲菲则是想的更多，身为露露的监护人皆保镖，菲菲可是知道的，露露从来没有交过异性的朋友，就算是同性的朋友，也不是很多。
这个人是从哪窜出来的？没听过丽露有这么一个朋友啊，而且，什么时候开始交的异性朋友了？为什么我会不知道呢？而且，看样子，还想隐瞒两人相识的事情，这到底是怎么回事？
看着不远处那仍然在打闹着的无言和露露，菲菲的疑问都快突破天际了。
“那个…请问你是？…”菲菲觉得，自己还是开口问问比较好。
正闹得欢的两人听到菲菲的声音同时一愣，反应过来之后，露露才发觉了一个很严重的问题。
“对了，你叫什么啊？我还不知道你的名字呢。”
无言只感觉自己脑袋的某根神经好像断掉了，这个半天然妹子还真是令人无语，感情你到现在才想起不知道我的名字……
而菲菲的疑惑就更多了，这…不是看起来很熟吗？这连名字都可以不知道的熟人，又是怎么样的一种交友境界啊！
无奈的摇了摇头，无言对着菲菲挥了挥手，笑嘻嘻的说道：“我叫无言，你好啊美女。”
“哦，原来你叫无言啊…”这是某恍然大悟的半天然少女。
“无言先生，您好，我叫菲菲。”看见无言好像真不是什么坏人的样子，菲菲也放开了，不过心中的疑惑却是仍然不见解决。
“请问，您与我家丽露认识？”

听到菲菲的话，无言和露露顿时对视了两眼，沉默了一会之后，异口同声的说道：
“不认识！”
菲菲眉毛一跳，看着眼前异常有默契的两人，颇有点勉强的笑了起来。
“是…是这样吗？…那，您这是来…”
看来在菲菲的心中，是认为无言是来找露露的呢。
无言古怪的挠了挠自己的头，到底应该怎么说呢？难道告诉她我不认识出巨兽森林的路，所以来求指引的吗？这…貌似有点丢人…
其实露露很想告诉他，你已经很丢人了…
无奈的摊了摊手，无言只能说道：“其实，我真是打酱油路过的…”
“……”菲菲已经不知道说什么好了，照理说对方不想说，她也不能勉强，要是无言是个不相干的人也就算了，不搭理他就行了，但是无论怎么看，他跟露露都好像是认识的样子，一时之间，就连精明能干的菲菲，也被无言的无赖给弄的没主意了。
身后的护卫们也是面面相觑，要是平时有人过来捣乱，他们早就一剑把对方送出视线外了，但是现在这种情况，他们还真没有说话的立场。
而且，经过刚才无言的一众表现之后，他们也无力去插手了。
场面一时之间变得有点尴尬，无言只能干笑了几声，谁让他那么不正经呢。
“那么，无言先生接下来打算…”沉思了一会之后，菲菲只能这么说道。
“那个…其实嘛…”
“其实他是迷路了，所以想要让我们带他出去！”到了这个时候，露露也不指望无言能说出什么正经事来了，直截了当的对着菲菲说出了无言心中可耻的‘秘密’。
无言脸上的笑容一僵，好吧，他敢肯定，露露绝对是想要报复他…
看着菲菲那副古怪的模样，无言泪流满面。
护卫们也不禁翻了一个白眼，折腾了半天，结果居然是一迷路的…
当然，也是看对方好像跟自己家小姐很熟的样子，要不然，一个陌生人跑来搞笑，下场应该跟他们放在一旁的魔兽尸体差不多…

The sudden roar of the Hedong lion shocked Feifei and a group of guards standing around Li Lulu. Even Wu Yan, who was standing five meters away, felt his forehead swell and almost threw the sword in his hand.
Lulu quickly ran up to Wu Yan with an angry look on her face and pointed at his nose. "Is this what you said I'd leave to you? Are you here for help, or are you here to make fun of me?"
Should Wu Yan feel a sense of accomplishment for being able to irritate the lively Lulu to this extent?
Looking at Lulu with an angry face, Wu Yan shrank his head and smiled brightly. "Well, don't I want to lighten the atmosphere?..."
"You...you're hopeless..." Lulu lowered her hands weakly, saying that she was helpless in response to the speechless words.
"I can't say much...isn't the effect pretty good?..."
At this time, Feifei and the guards felt a little confused.
It seems that this man and Lilu (Miss) are quite familiar, but since they are acquaintances, why didn't they say hello at the beginning?
Feifei, on the other hand, thought more. As Lulu's guardians and bodyguards, Feifei knew that Lulu had never made friends of the opposite sex, and even if she had friends of the same sex, she didn't have many.
Where did this person come from? I have never heard of Lilu having such a friend. Besides, when did she start making friends of the opposite sex? Why don't I know? Moreover, it seems that he wants to hide the fact that the two of them met. What is going on?
Looking at Wu Yan and Lulu who were still fighting not far away, Feifei's questions almost reached the sky.
"Um... who are you?..." Feifei felt that it would be better for her to ask.
The two people who were having fun were stunned when they heard Feifei's voice. After reacting, Lulu realized a very serious problem.
"By the way, what's your name? I don't know your name yet."
Wuyan felt as if a nerve in his head had been severed. This semi-natural girl is really speechless. You have never remembered that you don’t know my name until now...
And Feifei had even more doubts. Doesn't this... look familiar? What kind of state of making friends is this with an acquaintance whose name you don’t even know!
Shaking his head helplessly, Wuyan waved to Feifei and said with a smile: "My name is Wuyan, hello, beauty."
"Oh, so your name is Wu Yan..." This is a semi-natural girl who suddenly realized.
"Hello, Mr. Wuyan, my name is Feifei." Seeing that Wuyan really didn't seem like a bad person, Feifei let go, but the doubts in her heart were still not resolved.
"Excuse me, do you know my Lilu?"
After hearing Feifei's words, Wu Yan and Lulu immediately looked at each other. After a moment of silence, they said in unison:
"I don't know you!"
Feifei's eyebrows jumped, looking at the two people in front of her who had an unusual understanding, she smiled somewhat reluctantly.
"Is...is that so?...Then, you are here..."
It seems that in Feifei's mind, she thinks Wu Yan is here to find Lulu.
Wu Yan scratched his head strangely, what should he say? Should I tell her that I don't know the way out of the Giant Beast Forest, so I came here to ask for guidance? This...seems a bit embarrassing...
In fact, Lulu really wants to tell him that you are already very embarrassed...
He spread his hands helplessly and could only say, "Actually, I was just passing by..."
"..." Feifei didn't know what to say anymore. Logically speaking, the other party didn't want to talk, so she couldn't force it. If Wu Yan was an irrelevant person, forget it and just ignore him. But no matter how you looked at it, he and Lulu seemed to know each other. Suddenly, even the shrewd and capable Feifei was confused by Wu Yan's scoundrel.Got it.
The guards behind them also looked at each other in confusion. If someone usually came to cause trouble, they would have sent the opponent out of sight with a sword, but in this situation, they really had no position to speak.
Moreover, after all the silent performances just now, they were unable to intervene.
The scene became a little awkward for a moment, and Wu Yan could only laugh a few times. Who could make him so immoral?
"So, Mr. Wu Yan's next plan..." After pondering for a while, Feifei could only say this.
"Well...actually..."
"Actually, he's lost, so he wants us to take him out!" At this time, Lulu didn't expect Wu Yan to say anything serious, and bluntly told Feifei the shameful 'secret' in Wu Yan's heart.
The smile on Wu Yan's face froze. Well, he was sure that Lulu definitely wanted to take revenge on him...
Looking at Feifei's weird look, Wuyan burst into tears.
The guards couldn't help but roll their eyes. After struggling for a long time, they turned out to be lost...
Of course, it was also because the other party seemed to be very familiar with their lady. Otherwise, if a stranger came to make fun of him, the end would be similar to the corpse of the monster they put aside...
